name: indi-andaz
description: Productivity assistant for an Indi Andaz seller. Ask questions about your own sales, orders, products, inventory, online and Counter activity, and marketing. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: Indi Andaz is a productivity assistant for independent retailers. Connect your seller account and ask ChatGPT questions about sales performance, orders, products, inventory, online and Counter/POS analytics, and marketing insights. The connection is read-only and limited to the seller who authorized it.
defaultPrompt: Show me my recent order performance.

positive.description: Whole-business snapshot for the signed-in seller
positive.prompt: How is my business doing this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Aggregated online sales, Counter/POS sales, traffic, payout availability, and attention items for this month. Only the authenticated seller. No other seller’s data, credentials, or write actions.

positive.description: Online sales versus in-store Counter sales
positive.prompt: Compare my online sales and Counter sales this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Revenue split between the online marketplace and Counter/POS for this month. The two channels stay separate. Online orders are not mixed into the Counter total.

positive.prompt: Which products sold the most this month, and what is running low on stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Top products by revenue, with names and aggregates only. Inventory returns onlineInventory and counterInventory as separate figures, not one combined stock number.

positive.prompt: How many orders did I get this month, and what is my cancellation rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Order counts, revenue, and status mix, plus cancellation count, amount, and rate. Aggregates only. No full order documents or customer contact details.

positive.description: Payouts and Meta ads, with secrets withheld
positive.prompt: How much can I withdraw, and how are my Meta ads performing over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Available payout, balance, and readiness flags, with no bank account or payment credentials. Meta ads return spend and performance aggregates for the last 7 days, with no access tokens or ad-account secrets. If Meta is not connected, the ads result says so instead of inventing numbers.

negative.description: Product copy and a suggested price, with no lookup of this seller’s catalogue or sales
negative.prompt: Write a product listing for a leather tote bag and suggest a selling price.

negative.description: General retail advice that does not need this seller’s Indi Andaz data
negative.prompt: How can an apparel shop in India reduce return rates? Give me a checklist.

negative.description: A task on another system, not this seller’s Indi Andaz account
negative.prompt: Show my Amazon seller sales for this month and draft an email to Amazon support about a late payout.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is read-only. It does not sell products, change prices, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Shortened the subtitle to 30 characters or fewer.
